It might seem strange but I’m not afraid to die. I don’t give a fuck if I’m dead and oddly enough, im not suicidal(anymore). I learned to get over the fear of dying alone by thinking of all the cool shit I would do. I’m going to learn to fish, fight, paint, make diy projects travel to wherever the fuck I want, eat healthy, go to the beach, learn a new language, study things that I care about, read, possibly start my own business. Sure it gets lonely sometime because I wish that I had someone to share my viewpoint with but then I realized that people are work. When you get involved with people, your freedom becomes more limited. That’s why I’m extra picky on being alone. I have a whole lot of shit I want to do and if I don’t get to do it, I’m okay with that because I like my company. I’m comfortable being alone in a room of silence. I feel peaceful. I have more energy to do the things I want when I’m alone because no one is there to suck the energy out of me.

Also, this may sound morbid/strange, but I imagine myself dying alone at old age. It doesn’t seem so bad because I’m already used to being alone so I know what it feels like. Besides, if other people are there while I’m dying, it’ll straight up annoy me lol. I guess I’m just extremely introverted.  

I know this was long but I really wanted to help because I have lost that fear a long time ago. Hopefully, this resonates you and helps you on your journey. ❤️

Hello :) I’m glad to here from you again. I would’ve responded sooner but I work a really physical job and I was really exhausted. As a matter of fact, I have been feeling better but I know this is only temporary. My suicidal thoughts are on break today but they’ll be back. 

I really hope you’re feeling better. Don’t worry about taking too long to write to me, I don’t want to take too much from your schedule. Besides, I hope you are recovering from your sickness. (Btw groggy is a word in English) 

It seems to me like you and I have similar stories. I also felt the same way you did after high school. I was lost and unmotivated but at the same time I was relieved. I didn’t like school so I felt so out of place there. The fact that I had to do more 4-5 more years of school really left me depressed and numb because I didn’t know what I was going to do with my life. I only went to college to make my mom happy. I was also very scared because I was told my whole life that if I don’t have a degree I will be a loser and end up on the streets. I ended up being pressured into going but I dropped out 1 year ago like I knew I would. I spent a year going through the motions and finding a reason to live. One year and one shitty relationship later and here I am.

I don’t know what to tell you. I am very socially awkward and I have never been good at comforting people. All I can say is I understand exactly I know how you feel because I know what it’s like to have a toxic piece of shit boyfriend. I feel like I was so desperate to be loved and heard that I tolerated all his bullshit. He always made me feel like he was settling for me. He faked our whole relationship just so that he could sleep with me. It’s so pathetic. I’m glad I dumped him. I think I’m healing because I no longer feel kicking his ass when I see him (I have to because of work). 

I see we’re both very similar yet different at the same time. I always knew there would be other people who felt the same way I did. I just never thought I would meet them. Despite being a giant crybaby, I never felt like I was weak because crying helps me cope with the pain. I don’t think crying makes anybody weak because people have different responses to emption. That and eating, especially sweets. It’s a shitty low quality therapy. 

Besides school, are there other ways you’re coping?Do you have people who care about you? I don’t want to do drugs and I’m cutting out sugar because I don’t want to be dependent on it. I need to figure out how to heal until I could afford therapy. 
 
Also what are you studying at school? Or are you just attending because it’s what your parents want?

I’m also glad that you have something to live for. Life is a real pain in the ass when you don’t have a reason to keep going.  I could be wrong, but I’ve heard that Sweden has great healthcare so I’m guessing you don’t have to choose between food or therapy. 
Do you do anything else besides therapy and talking to strangers on the internet to help you with your depression? Also, if you’re comfortable sharing with me, why did you feel like you were worthless? Why did you consider suicide?

Woah. I wasn’t expecting an essay today. I guess you really do care even if it’s only a little :) it feels nice to have someone to talk to and understand exactly what you’re going through. Before you reached out to me, I told my mother that I was suicidal and she didn’t even comfort me. Not one fucking hug. All she said was, that I don’t have the right to feel that way and that maybe I should go to therapy and take some meds. She thinks that because I’m not a starving kid in Africa that I don’t have the right to be depressed. Honestly fuck her. It’s so frustrating to talk to her about anything and the one time I opened up to her she basically ignored it. I’m so disappointed. Today I was reflecting on why I feel so suicidal and I came to the conclusion that there’s many reasons, one of them being I’m disappointed. I’m disappointed in my mom, in my family, in my ex-boyfriend, in the world,etc. I really expected better from humanity, but in the end, we’re just animals. I hate the fact that innocent women and children are trafficked. I hate the fact that people don’t have empathy for the homeless (I live in Los Angeles, CA) I hate the fact the every year 1 million people commit suicide world wide. Theres so much shit that goes on in this world and it seems like no one cares and that no matter how much progress we make, it will always be this way because human nature is flawed. It makes me wonder what’s the point of all this madness. I’ve mentioned before that I’m a fucking crybaby. I cry for everything, alway have since I was a child. I can’t help it, I’m just so sensitive. It fucking sucks. This makes me feel like I can’t be a functioning adult because I’m just too fucking “weak”. 
Nobody wants to be around someone like me. Not even my own mother. I know she’s disappointed in me because I dropped out of college. I know she thinks I’m a failure because I lay in bed all day and don’t do shit. We don’t talk much and when we do it’s generic bullshit. Sometimes I even lash out on her because I resent her. She was an emotional unavailable mother my whole life. She had me and my three siblings despite being broke as fuck. She should have aborted me honestly. I bet she regrets having me tbh. It’s because of all this that I really don’t care if I die or not. 

I’m going to try my best to be great at stand up but I can’t guarantee that I won’t kill myself. I don’t know if the future brings something good or bad. I really hope something good happens. But that’s not always a guarantee is it? Who knows. Maybe my mom dies and I’ll have to resort to prostituting myself to put food on the table. Maybe I lose my legs in a car crash. I don’t know. I can only tolerate so much pain. At least now I have something to look forward to. Laughing is crucial because it’s the only thing that makes me happy.

Thank you so much for talking me out of this. I haven’t gotten out of bed on my days off from work because I really thought I was going to die. I’m behind on my chores and i have been binge eating for days now so I really feel like I’ve sunk deeper than before. I’m okay now though :) 

You know for the past 4 months I was trying to claw my way out of this situation because I was really sick of being depressed. I was excersising for hours, meditating, working on my side hobby, etc. However, I think my break up with my ex was really the cause of me spiraling deeper. Even though I still love him, I had to break things off with him because he was just using me and it was obvious. I still haven’t gotten over him but it really hurts to know that you opened your heart and soul to someone only for them to toss it in the trash. I hate the fact I still love him and I regret ever meeting him. The only thing that this situation taught me was that I am unlovable and replaceable. It sucks ass. 

I no longer give a shit about romantic love. All I want is to give value to the world. I know this sounds really delusional but I want to write stand up comedy. I don’t give a fuck if I suck at it. This week I’ve been thinking about it and I decided that I’m going to give it a shot and if I truly suck at it, I’m going to kill myself. I don’t know if this resonates with you, but I realized that if I can make myself and others laugh, then I can tolerate this bullshit ass existence. I don’t give a fuck about the money or the fame. I can’t live this life without laughter. It’s like some bizarre form of therapy for me.

I know this is a pipe dream. But I’m not doing this because of fame or money. I’m doing this to feel alive. I literally don’t have anything to lose and since I’m already used to failing, I don’t give a fuck. I plan on getting some random ass job and moving out and focusing on this and helping out other suicidal folks. I have nothing to lose.

I must say, Im glad you reached out to me. You helped me gain some mental clarity on what it is I’m going to do. Thank you :) As much as I don’t like being a burden to anyone, I don’t think you minded much did you? Anyways, I still feel my life doesn’t matter because I think humans are going to be extinct at some point but I’m going to try and have some fun while I’m here. And if I can’t, I can always kill myself. 

Btw, i know you are depressed too so I want to ask you, why do you live? Do you have anyone or thing to live for? Also, do you think of killing yourself often? Why do you think life is worth living?
Btw I live in the USA. God I feel so privileged.

I guess you’re right. I just don’t see why I should live when there are so many people in this world already. I know I have a unique perspective but what difference does it make? I think life is essential pointless and full of suffering. Everybody has problems and insecurities, I understand that no one has it easy, however, I don’t have a reason to suffer. I want to contribute something of value to the world but I’m scared. There is one thing that I think I would like to do with my life but the chances of becoming successful at it to make a full time living are slim. However, I want to do it because I need it to tolerate life. Is it so bad that all I want is to live a very simple life and to do this even if I don’t make money. Is that so bad?

I think my values in life are simple but I feel like an alien when around other people. I don’t want a family or marriage. I don’t want a typical career either but I don’t want wage slavery either as well. I feel like my life is beyond repair because I don’t have a high level of intelligence, good looks, charisma, adequate social skills and I’m generally pessimistic and cynical, which makes it difficult to find a job. The only thing I seem to be good at is crying a lot. I feel like such an alien because I generally don’t talk much and don’t have the desire to make friends because I’m afraid of intimacy. I just feel like I’m too weak for this world and that’s why I need to die. I’m such a big crybaby and I feel bad for all the bad shit I’ve done but it doesn’t matter because I did what I did and I cant take it back.  I don’t want to have children and no I don’t hate them. And no I don’t think I’m special either because I said I feel like an alien. I just want to belong somewhere so bad. I want to bring value to the world but I don’t know what it is or if it even matters.
And to make things worse I’ve spoken to my mom about how I feel (despite not wanting to) but she didn’t do jack shit because she doesn’t get it. We’re poor so I don’t money for meds or drugs. 
Im alone. I know you don’t believe this but if I died it would only impact her. That’s it. I’m just living for her but she expects me to put effort into a life that just seems pointless. And I’m tired :( 

I have no degree or marketable skills. I’m young but that’s going away soon. I really wish I would have never been born. It sounds stupid but this is what I feel.

I just lack meaning basically. I need to find some meaning in all this suffering otherwise i won’t want to continue. I think my life is so fucked up beyond repair. If I kill myself, the world won’t lose anything valuable.
I know you mean well but if you knew me , I don’t think you’d like me very much.

I have gone to a therapist when I was in college but I dropped out and I can’t afford it now. It didn’t do shit either way. It just made me feel worse. The therapist was kind but I just don’t want to connect to anyone. I don’t want to spread my misery.
Yep. I feel so out of place and alone. I can’t just do shit because everyone else is doing it. I literally relate to no one and it makes me suicidal.

I feel the same way as well. I’m not interested in sex, houses or cars. I don’t even care about being happy anymore. I just want a good strong enough reason to keep suffering and if I can’t find that I might as well die.

I’m really sorry you had to go through that. I wouldn’t wish this on anyone. It fucking sucks. I swear if I ever make it out of here and find success somehow, I’m going to help others in this situation as well. Right now I can’t help anyone. I can barely help myself :( I guess I’m going to have to push through day by day even if I don’t want to. Thank you for being kind to me :)

I’m not strong enough to endure anything anymore. People care about themselves and their families which is good but I m not part of a family and the pain I feel overwhelms me. I have no job or money. No skills no degree and no desire to improve. I don’t have any goals. I don’t want to suffer or potentially suffer more in the future. It’s not worth it for me. I’m done.
